ترتكبون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِبُونَ (tartakibūna) /tar.ta.ki.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# تُرْتَكَبُونَ (turtakabūna) /tur.ta.ka.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
